procedure.title: Review photo reconstruction
procedure.text: Confirm component labels, left/right input/output direction and the proposed optical path against the real bench. Replace provisional module and stage identities.

procedure.title: Record hardware and operating limits
procedure.text: Complete serials, calibration, fibre/connector ends, actual cut lengths, coupling type and angles. Enter the approved wavelength and DUT power limits; photos do not supply them.

procedure.title: Configure the actual chip measurement
procedure.text: Enter chip/device IDs, reference structures, scan and detector settings, data naming and approved local SOP. Verify camera/illumination links separately from the measurement signal.

procedure.title: Align and acquire under the approved SOP
procedure.text: Use the reviewed lab procedure for loading, alignment, reference acquisition, measurements and acceptance checks. This working outline does not approve hardware operation.

procedure.title: Retain results and review the setup
procedure.text: Save raw/reference data and configuration; record post-processing and measured timings. Save the editable setup, then explicitly publish a reviewed snapshot if appropriate.
